extra_quotes: Magnetospectroscopy in transmission configuration was performed using a vacuum Fourier-transform infrared (FTIR) spectrometer equipped with a cryogenic bolometer detector positioned beneath the sample chamber [Fig. 2(a)].
Measurements were conducted at 4.2 K in magnetic fields of up to 16 T with a step size of 0.25 T and a spectral resolution of 2.0 cm−1 ˆ = 0.06 THz.
